output.reason: Symptom-based management discussion and options counseling for presumed menopausal transition require clinician assessment but do not establish time-critical urgency.

A 52-year-old reporting hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods requests discussion of treatment options, which requires clinician assessment of history and risks before hormonal or non-hormonal therapy, but reports nothing time-critical.
output.patientMessage: Your symptoms fit a perimenopausal pattern, and choosing between hormonal and non-hormonal options needs a clinician to review your medical history and preferences. I've asked for Counsel clinician review in this thread; I can't promise a reply time or a prescription. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. Seek prompt care for heavy or unexpected vaginal bleeding, chest pain, or new severe symptoms.
differential: Other cause of vasomotor symptoms or cycle change, e.g. thyroid dysfunction, not excluded
